title: YOUR RIVAL
note: Your first real battle. Your rival took the starter that beats yours, on purpose.

title: ROXANNE
note: Rock types, all the way down. Water and Grass make this short.

title: YOUR RIVAL
note: They find you just outside Rustboro. Two Pokémon this time.

title: BRAWLY
note: Fighting types in a very dark gym. The lights come back as you win.

title: YOUR RIVAL
note: A mid-route ambush on the way to Mauville. Three Pokémon now.

title: WALLY
note: One Ralts and a lot of enthusiasm. Remember this kid.

title: WATTSON
note: Electric types. A Ground type turns this whole gym off.

title: MAXIE
note: The boss of Team Magma, at the top of a volcano.

title: FLANNERY
note: Fire types, ending on a very sturdy Torkoal.

title: NORMAN
note: Your dad. His Slaking hits like a truck, then loafs around every other turn.

title: SHELLY
note: Team Aqua has taken over the Institute, and they're blocking Route 119 until you clear it.

title: YOUR RIVAL
note: Win and they hand you HM02 Fly. Worth it.

title: WINONA
note: Flying types with a Skarmory and an Altaria to wrap it up.

title: YOUR RIVAL
note: Your last battle with your rival, and their full team.

title: MAXIE
note: Deep under Jagged Pass. This is where Groudon wakes up.

title: MATT
note: Team Aqua's admin, stalling while they make off in a stolen submarine.

title: TATE & LIZA
note: A double battle. Your team has to work in pairs here.

title: ARCHIE
note: The boss of Team Aqua, at the bottom of the sea. You'll need Dive to get here.

title: JUAN
note: Water types, ending on a Kingdra that almost nothing hits hard.

title: WALLY
note: Remember that kid with the Ralts? Not so little now.

title: SIDNEY
note: Dark types. First door of four.

title: PHOEBE
note: Ghost types. Normal and Fighting moves do nothing here.

title: GLACIA
note: Ice types, many of them part Water.

title: DRAKE
note: Dragons and a very fast finish. Ice moves earn their slot here.

title: WALLACE
note: The last door. Six Pokémon, and Milotic waits at the end.
